comparison.objective: Transfer sample into acceptable tubes and move matching checklist tabs without falsifying an unacceptable fourth sample.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated pipette handling, dose transfer, and paired physical record actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Three tubes are filled to their marks and correctly ticked; the fourth remains empty and unticked; water or a false tick invalidates the trial.
comparison.reason: The record tests sample integrity and fill/record correspondence, not socket manipulation or damper commissioning.
